comment: Scripted games for cross-emulator differential testing (tools/diff_test.py). Player moves are key sequences; the AI reply is deterministic with FRAMES pinned to 0. Moves only need to pass the game's minimal validation (white source, non-white destination) - some are deliberately unorthodox to reach promotion/game-over quickly, and 'captures' includes a move that gets rejected (source captured by the AI) to exercise the input retry path.
